ov: A Mexican salamander that never goes through metamorphosis: adults keep their feathery external gills and stay in the water. It’s famous for regrowing limbs, gills and parts of its eyes and brain.
rg: Wild only in lakes of the Mexican highlands, most now covered by Mexico City.
fx: Only about 50 to 1,000 adults are left in the wild, but a large captive population is kept worldwide.
